name: divini-procure
description: Divini Procure - procurement marketplace (Vite SPA + Express/Postgres backend, Authentik OIDC, local-disk storage)

scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://divini:devpass@localhost:5432/divini_test}" SESSION_SECRET="${SESSION_SECRET:-dev-only-session-secret-change-me}" node --experimental-strip-types --test-concurrency=6 --test "tests/integration/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:server && rm -rf server/dist/public && cp -r dist server/dist/public
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,yellow "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron dist-electron/main.js"
scripts.electron:build: ELECTRON=true vite build && npm run electron:compile
scripts.app:build: npm run build && npx cap sync
